purpose: Screen whether removing independent upper-body performance improves gait continuity while preserving the same-source-time A/B assembly rule.

canonical_source.role: Flow input for both the historical and new clothing edits

kimono_reference.role: Garment reference for B; exclude all non-garment elements

a_existing_output.role: Historical A candidate with independent parasol/upper-body acting

A.name: existing_tokyo_parasol
A.upper_body: independent parasol handling, sideways glance, faint smile; original pouch removed

B.name: new_clothing_only_kimono
B.upper_body: preserve source arms, hands, head direction, gaze, facial expression, pouch and timing; no added performance

assembly.audio: not included in the silent diagnostic; preserve production audio when promoting a candidate

verification_plan.reuse: analysis/clothing-only-ab-2026-09-06/run_clothing_only_ab.py (imports the prior same-time renderer; does not run without an explicit downloaded B path)
verification_plan.required_new_input: Completed: downloaded B Flow output was probed, hashed and rendered from the actual local path recorded under variants.B.
outputs: paired full-body frames for screen position, head direction and apparent size
verification_plan.decision: B is a viable clothing-only candidate for the next assembly: the matched-clock frame sheets show no new visible gait restart and remove the requested independent upper-body acting. This is not anatomical pixel-identical gait certification.

visual_review: At global 6.500–6.708s, B preserves the same broad lower-body progression as A under identical source-clock mapping.
B retains the source handheld pouch and source-facing head/upper-body behavior; A contains the historical parasol performance, so B has a simpler and more controllable transition silhouette.
Raw Seoul/A/B matched-time lower-body samples show compatible alternating-foot progression; residual garment and footwear silhouette differences remain.
This is a 1.5-second transition screening, not approval of the full 13-second sequence.

constraints: Do not overwrite A or the canonical source.
Do not render before B is downloaded from Flow; the analysis script exits if the B path is missing.
Do not change ticket geometry, mask, camera or playback factor during this isolated test.
A versus B is a screening comparison against an independently generated historical render; stochastic generation prevents a causal claim.
